strengths: The severe editorial typography, restrained red/amber/green signals, monospaced technical detail and visible arithmetic feel native to database safety rather than applied as a software-brand costume.
The migration plan is exceptionally effective product evidence: it demonstrates the output, reasoning, thresholds and operational context at the exact moment the central safety claim is made.
Desktop pages sustain a rigorous grid, consistent rules and unusually disciplined spacing across product explanation, pricing and security content.
Mobile is genuinely recomposed: dense plan and check content becomes readable stacked evidence while preserving identifiers, statuses and technical hierarchy.
Pricing and security address commercial and technical scrutiny directly, with concrete packaging, access grants and limitations instead of generic reassurance.

defects.detail: The home-page sidebar introduction labeled “The whole argument” is visually too quiet relative to its strategic importance and can be missed before the plan begins.
The disabled-looking dark header CTA has very low-contrast text, making the primary action appear unavailable on both desktop and mobile.
The mobile header consumes substantial vertical space and separates the CTA onto its own row without turning that extra height into stronger navigation or conversion hierarchy.
Several mobile sections retain generous desktop-derived vertical gaps, particularly before the checks groupings, producing avoidable dead space in an already long technical read.

The strong quantitative claims and testimonial are presented with authentic visual authority but have little nearby qualification; although the footer discloses the prototype, the evidence could be mistaken for substantiated customer proof before that point.

There are intentionally no photographs; the data-drawn product diagrams are highly suitable, but the site depends almost entirely on one visual language and offers limited variation across longer pages.

summary: This is strong, business-specific design whose restraint, technical precision and real-output centerpiece make the safety proposition unusually credible. The system holds together across product, pricing, security and mobile views; remaining issues are mostly CTA contrast, excess mobile spacing and clearer qualification of invented proof.
